anya: quick heads-up - onboarding argo-60k-int3 hit a deterministic mismatch at the RoPE wrap boundary. small repro attached.

anya: short repro (runs <20s):
```bash
./smoke_longctx.sh --model argo-60k-int3 --quant int3 --context 60000 --prompt fixtures/repeat-4k.txt --seed 7
```

anya: trimmed log: 
```
[2026-02-08T11:03:12Z] i=3996 emit=\"and\" kv=3996 fp=0x5c9a phase=0x7ffb
[2026-02-08T11:03:13Z] i=4095 emit=\"the\" kv=4095 fp=0x7fff phase=0x7fff
[2026-02-08T11:03:13Z] i=4096 emit=\"<BAD>\" kv=4096 fp=0x8001 phase=0x8001  # sudden fingerprint/phase jump
```

sam: does fp16 baseline reproduce? also try int4-hybrid.

anya: argo-60k-fp16 is clean. int4-hybrid shows minor drift but nothing like int3. Repro is deterministic across restarts with same seed.

lia: can you dump keys 4088..4100 with phases? kv-dump --range 4088-4100 --json works.

anya: kv-dump output (excerpt):
```
4088 key=0x1a11 phase=0x7ff8
4094 key=0x1a9f phase=0x7ffd
4095 key=0x1af3 phase=0x7fff
4096 key=0x2b01 phase=0x8001  # wrap at boundary
4097 key=0x2b02 phase=0x8002
```

zhang: that looks exactly like a 2^15 phase rollover. probable interaction: int3 kernel computes rotary cos/sin with reduced precision and step quantization. Two actionable checks: 1) run fp32 rotary-only trace for positions 4090-4100 and compare; 2) build int3 with rotary-legacy path (no interpolation) and retest.

ci-bot: auto-eval summary (short-holdout):
- argo-60k-fp16: ppl pre-roll 6.9, post-roll 7.0
- argo-60k-int4: ppl pre-roll 7.1, post-roll 7.4
- argo-60k-int3: ppl pre-roll 7.3, post-roll 9.8  (tail regression ~+40%)

sam: agree triage: bisect last 4 commits to kernels/rotary*, add a CI regression that runs the short repro under emulated int3, and add a kv-fingerprint assert. lia — can you add the CI job?

lia: will add tests/regressions/ropex_rollover_mini.py to run in unit-time and assert no fp discontinuity. also adding telemetry alert if kv fingerprint delta > threshold across a request.

anya: filed issue INF-4419 with repro, kv-dump, and eval summary; PR incoming with the mini-test and kv-assert.
